messages: lina: Heads-up — docsite deploy failed on prod after moving /assets to CDN. images 404 + sidebar pages occasionally 302 -> infinite redirect in browsers. Repro with /guides/deploy at top of doc. ci-bot: [deploy] 🛑 Build failed: LinkCheck error: 302 redirect detected for /assets/icons/logo.svg -> https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/icons/logo.svg. See CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/1234 ethan: @lina can you paste the failing link? Is it a relative -> absolute rewrite issue? lina: Here's the snippet from the generated HTML: `` served from /guides/deploy -> browser requests /guides/assets/icons/logo.svg which 302s to /assets/... then back to /guides/assets... weird. kai: Looks like mkdocs' use_directory_urls + our rewrite plugin is munging relative paths when base_url differs. I can push a patch: force absolute root paths for assets in the build. Quick test command: ``` # replace relative asset refs in HTML outputs find site -name '*.html' -exec sed -i 's/src=\"\..\/.assets\//src=\"\/.assets\//g' {} + ``` maya: That sed is fine as a stopgap for CI, but we should fix upstream in the theme/template. Also add a redirect in nginx to normalize /guides/assets -> /assets to avoid loops. ethan: Created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 — includes sed hack + nginx redirect + unit test for linkcheck. PTAL @kai @lina kai: Reviewed, left one comment about test flakiness. I'll take that after merge. If we ship the redirect, it should break the loop immediately. lina: After applying the redirect in staging, I re-ran linkcheck — passes. Deployed to prod and verified images render. Thanks team :tada: ethan: We'll follow up with a proper theme patch to avoid sed in build pipeline. Adding a ticket to track: DOCS-312 maya: Noted. I'll add a short migration note in the changelog about the CDN move so integrators know to use /assets absolute paths. ci-bot: [deploy] ✅ Build passed on branch docs/fix-assets (job 4578) lina: Closing thread, moving remaining items to DOCS-312. :lock_with_ink_pen:
